name: 07112 · Newark, NJ
findings: ZIP 07112 (Newark) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07112 (Newark) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07112 (Newark) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).
